config.title: Simple AI Committer
config.apiBaseUrl.description: OpenAI-compatible API base URL (default: DeepSeek). Enter it directly or run 'Simple AI Committer: Select API Base URL'. Changing the request destination, including path or query, requires approval before sending a stored key.
config.apiKey.description: API key bound to the endpoint. Prefer 'Simple AI Committer: Set API Key' for password input. ***** indicates a stored key and is restored in an empty field on startup without a network check. HTTP 401 clears the rejected key and mask; 403/network errors retain them. Plaintext requires migration or explicit window authorization; migration masks settings and removes identical accessible copies.
config.model.description: Model name to use (e.g. deepseek-flash, kimi-for-coding, gpt-6-luna)
config.systemPrompt.description: Custom system prompt sent to the LLM. The value shown above is the built-in English default; for the zh-cn display language a Chinese prompt is used until you change it.
config.maxDiffChars.description: Maximum diff characters, including file summaries and truncation notices. Must be a positive integer.
config.temperature.description: AI generation temperature (0-2); lower is more stable on models that still accept it. Default: -1 (omit the parameter), required by fixed-temperature models such as Claude, GPT-5.x and Kimi. Set 0-2 explicitly only for models that accept it.
config.timeoutMs.description: Total API request deadline in milliseconds (1-2147483647), including connection and response reception
config.gitPath.description: Git executable name or absolute path; spaces are supported (e.g. C:\Program Files\Git\bin\git.exe). Do not add quotes or arguments. Each Git command has a fixed 30-second deadline.
